text.description_html:
Von Duprin Crash Bar Type Vertical Rod Exit Device, Polished Brass

This Von Duprin 8827 for doors unto 4 feet wide and 10 feet high with the included 3 foot extension rod.

Von Duprin Series 8827 Exit devices are UL listed from Accident Hazard and Fire Exit Hardware, and are tested in accordance to ANSI A156.3, 1994, Grade1.

All necessary mounting hardware is included.

Specifications: for Von Duprin 8827 Vertical Rod Exit Device

  • Field Reversible Handing
  • Field Sizeable
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Hex Key Dogging
  • Crossbar Projection Neutral: 4-3/4"
  • Crossbar Length: 42"
  • Lock Stile Case: 8-1/4"x2-3/4"x15/16"
  • Hinge Stile Case: 6"x1-3/4"x15/16"
  • Crossbar Diameter: 1"
  • Grade 1
  • Von Duprin 8827 Installation Template
  • Von Duprin 8827 Parts Manual
